note: Triennial election of the rural district council (29 divisions), 1936: nominations received by W. R. Bell, J.P., 28 April 1936. Party labels are not printed for the unopposed members. No nominations for Camly, Creggan, Drumbanagher, Lathbirget, Mountnorris, Mullaghbane, Poyntzpass and Tullyhappy, where the sitting members (not named) were automatically re-elected. Polled 28 May 1936. Printed "Moybane, Crossmaglen". King was the outgoing member.
